text: ‘Ei dad’ yw tad bachgen. Sut mae dweud tad merch?
gloss: 'Ei dad' is a boy's father. How do you say a girl's father? — 'ei thad': feminine 'ei' (her) takes the aspirate mutation, t → th.

text: O ‘coed’ cawn ‘coeden’. Sut mae dweud un o'r ‘mefus’?
gloss: From 'coed' (trees) we get 'coeden' (one tree). How do you say one of the 'mefus' (strawberries)? — 'Mefusen': the singulative -en, as in coed → coeden.

text: Yn llythrennol, ‘dau naw’ yw ‘deunaw’. Pa rif yw e?
gloss: Literally, 'deunaw' is 'two nines'. Which number is it? — 18: two times nine.

text: ‘Tref y ffynnon’ yw ystyr ‘Treffynnon’. Beth yw ei henw yn Saesneg?
gloss: 'Treffynnon' means 'town of the well'. What is its English name? — Holywell (Flintshire), named after St Winefride's Well; the only option with 'well'.

text: Ar label dilledyn, beth mae llun o fowlen ddŵr â llaw ynddi yn ei olygu?
gloss: On a clothing label, what does a tub of water with a hand in it mean? — Hand wash.

text: Mewn e-bost, beth mae rhoi pobl yn y maes ‘Bcc’ yn ei wneud?
gloss: In an email, what does putting people in the 'Bcc' field do? — Hides their addresses from the other recipients (blind carbon copy).

text: Mewn rygbi'r undeb, sawl pwynt sy'n dod o sgorio cais?
gloss: In rugby union, how many points does scoring a try give? — Five (it was four until 1992).

text: Beth sy'n cael ei ychwanegu at espresso i wneud latte?
gloss: What is added to an espresso to make a latte? — Steamed milk.

text: Ym mha gêm fideo mae chwaraewyr yn cloddio ac yn adeiladu byd cyfan o flociau sgwâr?
gloss: In which video game do players mine and build a whole world of square blocks? — Minecraft.

text: Pa offeryn sy'n cael ei ystyried yn offeryn cenedlaethol Cymru?
gloss: Which instrument is regarded as the national instrument of Wales? — The harp (the triple harp especially); crwth and pibgorn are old Welsh instruments too, but not the national one.

text: Dydd Santes Dwynwen, ar 25 Ionawr, yw fersiwn Cymru o ba ddiwrnod?
gloss: St Dwynwen's Day, 25 January, is Wales's version of which day? — Valentine's Day: Dwynwen is the Welsh patron saint of lovers.

text: Ar botel eli haul, am beth mae'r rhif SPF yn sôn?
options: Pa mor dal dŵr yw'r eli
Am faint mae'n cadw ar ôl agor
gloss: On a bottle of sun cream, what does the SPF number tell you? — How much protection it gives against sunburn (Sun Protection Factor).

text: Pa fynydd y gallwch chi ei ddringo ar drên bach sy'n cychwyn yn Llanberis?
gloss: Which mountain can you climb on a little train that starts in Llanberis? — Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon), by the Snowdon Mountain Railway.

text: Pa greadur bach sy'n gallu trosglwyddo clefyd Lyme wrth frathu?
gloss: Which small creature can pass on Lyme disease when it bites? — The tick (trogen); hence checking your skin after walking in long grass or bracken.

text: Ym mha dref ym Mro Morgannwg mae teulu Stacey yn byw yn ‘Gavin & Stacey’?
gloss: In which Vale of Glamorgan town does Stacey's family live in 'Gavin & Stacey'? — Barry (Y Barri).

text: Pa fwyd Cymreig sy'n cael ei wneud o wymon wedi'i ferwi am oriau?
gloss: Which Welsh food is made from seaweed boiled for hours? — Laverbread (bara lawr), often fried with cockles and bacon; bara brith is fruit loaf, picau ar y maen Welsh cakes.

text: I ba glwb yn Sbaen yr ymunodd Gareth Bale o Tottenham yn 2013?
gloss: Which Spanish club did Gareth Bale join from Tottenham in 2013? — Real Madrid.

text: Pa fardd o Abertawe a ysgrifennodd ‘Under Milk Wood’?
gloss: Which Swansea poet wrote 'Under Milk Wood'? — Dylan Thomas; the other three are also Thomases.

text: Pam mae halen yn cael ei daenu ar ffyrdd yn y gaeaf?
gloss: Why is salt spread on roads in winter? — It lowers the freezing point of water, so ice melts.

text: Pa anifail gwyllt ym Mhrydain sy'n gaeafgysgu mewn nyth o ddail?
gloss: Which wild animal in Britain hibernates in a nest of leaves? — The hedgehog; grey squirrels, foxes and badgers stay active through winter.

text: Wrth hedfan o Gaerdydd i Efrog Newydd, sawl awr mae'r cloc yn mynd yn ôl?
gloss: Flying from Cardiff to New York, how many hours does the clock go back? — 5 hours (New York is on Eastern Time, five behind the UK for most of the year).

text: Pa artist graffiti dienw sy'n enwog am ei stensiliau ar waliau ledled y byd?
gloss: Which anonymous graffiti artist is famous for his stencils on walls around the world? — Banksy.

text: Pa nofelydd a greodd y ditectif o Wlad Belg, Hercule Poirot?
gloss: Which novelist created the Belgian detective Hercule Poirot? — Agatha Christie.

text: Ym mha gyfres mae Eleven a'i ffrindiau yn ymladd y Demogorgon yn nhref Hawkins?
gloss: In which series do Eleven and her friends fight the Demogorgon in the town of Hawkins? — Stranger Things (Netflix, 2016–2025).

text: Yn ôl y chwedl, pwy oedd Gelert, sy'n rhoi ei enw i Feddgelert?
gloss: According to the legend, who was Gelert, who gives his name to Beddgelert? — Llywelyn's faithful hound, killed in error after saving the baby.

text: Beth oedd yn cael ei gloddio yn chwareli mawr Bethesda a Llanberis?
gloss: What was dug in the great quarries of Bethesda and Llanberis? — Slate (Penrhyn and Dinorwig quarries).

text: Mewn mis Chwefror o 28 diwrnod, sawl dydd Sul sydd yna?
gloss: In a 28-day February, how many Sundays are there? — Four: 28 days are exactly four whole weeks, so every weekday occurs four times.

text: Ar gyfrifiadur Windows, beth mae Ctrl+Z yn ei wneud fel arfer?
gloss: On a Windows computer, what does Ctrl+Z usually do? — Undo the last action.

text: Mae ‘Bangor’ yn troi'n ‘ym Mangor’. Sut mae dweud ‘yn’ + ‘Dinbych’?
gloss: 'Bangor' becomes 'ym Mangor'. How do you say 'in' + 'Dinbych' (Denbigh)? — 'yn Ninbych': after 'yn' the nasal mutation turns d into n.

text: Beth yw prif gynhwysyn hwmws?
gloss: What is the main ingredient of hummus? — Chickpeas (gwygbys).

text: Pa aderyn ysglyfaethus a achubwyd rhag diflannu o Gymru, ac sy'n cael ei fwydo bob dydd ger Rhaeadr?
gloss: Which bird of prey was saved from vanishing from Wales and is fed every day near Rhayader? — The red kite (Gigrin Farm feeding station).

text: Pa fand o Gwmaman a ganodd ‘Dakota’ a ‘Have a Nice Day’?
gloss: Which band from Cwmaman sang 'Dakota' and 'Have a Nice Day'? — Stereophonics.

text: Pa ddinas sydd ar ddwy lan y Bosphorus, yn Ewrop ac yn Asia?
gloss: Which city lies on both banks of the Bosphorus, in Europe and in Asia? — Istanbul.

text: Beth yw'r llinellau gwyn y mae awyrennau'n eu gadael yn uchel yn yr awyr?
gloss: What are the white lines planes leave high in the sky? — Contrails: water vapour from the engines that condenses and freezes into ice crystals.

text: Mewn cyfeiriad gwe, am beth mae'r ‘S’ yn ‘https’ yn sefyll?
gloss: In a web address, what does the 'S' in 'https' stand for? — Secure (HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure).

text: Pa arweinydd a gynhaliodd senedd ym Machynlleth ym 1404?
gloss: Which leader held a parliament at Machynlleth in 1404? — Owain Glyndŵr.

text: Pwy ysgrifennodd ‘Animal Farm’, lle mae'r moch yn cipio'r fferm?
gloss: Who wrote 'Animal Farm', in which the pigs take over the farm? — George Orwell.

text: Pa arlunydd o Fôn a baentiodd dirluniau Eryri â chyllell balet a phaent trwchus?
gloss: Which Anglesey painter painted Snowdonia landscapes with a palette knife and thick paint? — Sir Kyffin Williams (born in Llangefni).

text: Pa gwmni o Ddenmarc sy'n gwneud y briciau tegan plastig enwocaf yn y byd?
gloss: Which Danish company makes the world's best-known plastic toy bricks? — Lego (Playmobil is German, Mattel and Hasbro American).

text: Pa wlad chwedlonol a foddwyd dan Fae Ceredigion pan adawyd y llifddorau ar agor?
gloss: Which legendary land was drowned under Cardigan Bay when the sluice gates were left open? — Cantre'r Gwaelod (the drunken Seithennin's fault, in the best-known telling); its bells are said to ring under the sea.

text: Ym mha ras y bu Colin Jackson o Gaerdydd yn bencampwr y byd?
gloss: In which race was Cardiff's Colin Jackson world champion? — The 110 metres hurdles (1993 and 1999).

text: Mae'r daith i'r gwaith yn cymryd 35 munud a'r gwaith yn dechrau am 8:45. Pryd mae'n rhaid gadael fan bellaf?
gloss: The journey to work takes 35 minutes and work starts at 8:45. When must you leave at the latest? — 8:10: 8:45 minus 35 minutes.

text: Pa beiriannydd a gynlluniodd Bont y Borth dros y Fenai, a agorodd ym 1826?
gloss: Which engineer designed the Menai Suspension Bridge (Pont y Borth), opened in 1826? — Thomas Telford; Robert Stephenson built the nearby Britannia Bridge.

text: Mae'r Lleuad yn llawn heno. Sut olwg fydd arni ymhen tua phythefnos?
gloss: The Moon is full tonight. What will it look like in about a fortnight? — A new moon: the cycle is about 29.5 days, so half of it later the Moon is new.

text: Mae enw un o fisoedd y flwyddyn yn Gymraeg yn golygu ‘diwedd yr haf’. Pa un?
gloss: One Welsh month name means 'the end of summer'. Which? — Gorffennaf (July), from 'gorffen' (finish) + 'haf' (summer).

text: Cyn cyngerdd, pa offeryn sydd fel arfer yn rhoi'r nodyn A i'r gerddorfa diwnio iddo?
gloss: Before a concert, which instrument usually gives the orchestra the A to tune to? — The oboe.

text: Pa awdur o Rosgadfan a ysgrifennodd ‘Te yn y Grug’ a ‘Traed mewn Cyffion’?
gloss: Which author from Rhosgadfan wrote 'Te yn y Grug' and 'Traed mewn Cyffion'? — Kate Roberts.

text: Pa wyddonydd o Abertawe a ddyfeisiodd y gell danwydd yn y 19eg ganrif?
gloss: Which Swansea-born scientist invented the fuel cell in the 19th century? — Sir William Robert Grove (his 'gas voltaic battery', 1839–42).

text: O ba borthladd yr hwyliodd y Mimosa ym 1865 â'r ymfudwyr cyntaf i Batagonia?
gloss: From which port did the Mimosa sail in 1865 with the first emigrants to Patagonia? — Liverpool (Lerpwl).

text: Pa fathemategydd o Ddinbych-y-pysgod a gyflwynodd yr arwydd ‘=’ ym 1557?
gloss: Which Tenby mathematician introduced the '=' sign in 1557? — Robert Recorde, in 'The Whetstone of Witte'; William Jones, the Anglesey man who introduced π, is the trap.
